name: Emberhall
summary: A nine-page restaurant back office in frosted glass, with a floor plan and a kitchen board
about: A frosted-glass back office for a grill and chai restaurant in Lahore. Seat parties on a live floor plan where the table glows and the chairs fill in, send dishes to a kitchen board whose tickets fly across and turn red when late, and watch the pantry switch dishes off when an ingredient runs out. Bookings, orders, the team and reports sit alongside; good for a restaurant, bistro or cafe.
how: Open the Floor plan and tap a free table: choose guests and a server, then Seat guests to watch the chairs fill.
On a seated table, Add dishes and Send to kitchen; the ticket flies to the Kitchen page and the pantry stock drops.
On the Kitchen board, drag tickets from New to Cooking to Ready to Served, or use Bump and Move; timers turn red after 15 minutes.
Ask for the bill, Settle with cash, card or wallet, then mark the table clean to free it.
Use Edit layout to drag tables around the room (arrow keys nudge a selected table) or add a new one.
On Bookings, pick a day, add a reservation and seat it onto a free table when the party arrives.
86 a dish on the Menu, receive a delivery in the Pantry, switch Reports between 7D, 30D and 12M, and open Settings from the gear.
